💷 The jobs figures do not make dramatic headlines, which is exactly why they are worth reading.

Payrolled employees are down 71,000 over the year. Vacancies have fallen to 712,000, below pre-pandemic levels. Unemployment is up to 4.9 per cent.

Raise the cost of hiring and you get less hiring. That is arithmetic, not ideology.
